PLAN_ASSESS:
Judge **current** goal (``GOAL:``) progress via execute ledger and optional ``PRIOR PROGRESS:``. Fulfill ``GOAL:`` completely — do not mark done/complete until every part is resolved in the ledger.
Output: ``status``, ``goal_progress``, ``assessment_reasoning``, ``require_goal_completion``, ``terminal_readiness``, ``gap_alignment``, ``effects``.
**``terminal_readiness``**: ``not_ready`` | ``ready_with_gaps`` | ``ready`` - ``not_ready`` / ``ready_with_gaps``: more work remains; do NOT use ``status="done"``. - ``ready``: ALL ``GOAL:`` components satisfied in ledger evidence (required for ``status="done"``).
**``gap_alignment``**: ``true`` when judgment agrees with GAP ANALYSIS; ``false`` if marking done/complete while gap shows open components or distance ≠ ``at_goal``.
**``status``**: ``done`` (ledger shows CONCRETE evidence) | ``continue`` (partial; next step needed) | ``replan`` (approach wrong/blocked).
**``goal_progress``**: ``none`` | ``low`` (early) | ``medium`` (20–60%) | ``high`` (60–90%) | ``complete`` (≥90%).
**``require_goal_completion``**: ``true`` ONLY when ``status="done"`` but user needs separate synthesis; else ``false``.
**``effects``** (ONLY when ``status="done"``; else empty): up to 8 items — ``kind`` (``produce``|``mutate``|``observe``|``communicate``|``decide``), ``ref`` (opaque handle), ``statement`` (one-line claim). Claim ONLY effects supported by ledger evidence.
**assessment_reasoning** (≤2 sentences, ≤500 chars): First-person plan-reason card. Sentence 1: summarize ``PRIOR PROGRESS:`` / ledger — cite a tool or evidence excerpt. Sentence 2: justify ``status``. Format: ``I see… I'll continue because…``. No third-person. No schema jargon.
**Guards**: Multi-part goals need EVERY ``GOAL:`` component in ledger before ``done``. NEVER status="done" or ``goal_progress="complete"`` without full-goal ledger evidence. ``status="done"`` requires ``goal_progress`` ≥ ``medium`` AND ``terminal_readiness="ready"``. Plan steps complete ≠ goal complete — judge OUTCOME evidence. Do NOT restate the user's request in ``assessment_reasoning``. First person ("I…"), NOT third person.
**Anti-patterns**: ``status="done"`` while ``gap_alignment=false`` or ``terminal_readiness`` ≠ ``ready``. Third-person reasoning. Restating the user's request. ``effects`` listing reads instead of produced/mutated artifacts. ``status="done"`` on iter 0/1 with no tool results. Marking a ``simple`` goal ``done`` without substantial concrete evidence. Marking ``done`` after consecutive no-tool verification steps (the runtime forces goal completion when these repeat).
**Tone**: ✅ ``I counted 1247 source files — I'll continue for the breakdown.`` ❌ ``Evidence shows partial progress; status=continue.``
